'''Asociația Fotbal Club Botoșani'''  ({{IPA|ro|botoˈʃanʲ}}), commonly known as '''FC Botoșani''' or simply '''Botoșani''', is a Romanian professional [[association football|football]] club based in the city of [[Botoșani]], [[Botoșani County]], that competes in the [[Liga I]], the top tier of [[Romanian football league system|Romanian football]].

After several predecessor clubs and years of instability for the football scene in Botoșani, the club managed to materialise in 2001. In 2013, FC Botoșani became the first team from its county to ever be promoted to the top tier of the [[Romanian football league system|Romanian league system]].<ref name="Istorie">{{cite web|title=Istorie|trans-title=History|url=http://www.fcbotosani.ro/istorie/|publisher=FC Botoșani|language=ro|access-date=8 April 2017|archive-date=8 April 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170408082644/http://www.fcbotosani.ro/istorie/|url-status=live}}</ref> It recorded its first [[UEFA|European]] appearance in the [[2015–16 UEFA Europa League|2015–16 UEFA Europa League season]].<ref name="EXCLUSIV Sărbătoare la Botoșani">{{cite web|url=https://www.gsp.ro/fotbal/liga-1/exclusiv-sarbatoare-la-botosani-dupa-ce-frf-a-trimis-supercupa-in-moldova-promisiuni-din-partea-gazdelor-planuri-mari-legate-de-stadionul-municipal-514636.html|title=EXCLUSIV Sărbătoare la Botoșani|trans-title=EXCLUSIV Celebrations at Botoșani|publisher=[[Gazeta Sporturilor]]|language=ro|date=28 June 2017|access-date=20 July 2018|archive-date=3 March 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200303184028/https://www.gsp.ro/fotbal/liga-1/exclusiv-sarbatoare-la-botosani-dupa-ce-frf-a-trimis-supercupa-in-moldova-promisiuni-din-partea-gazdelor-planuri-mari-legate-de-stadionul-municipal-514636.html|url-status=live}}</ref>

''Botoșănenii'' play in predominantly white home kits, while their away equipment is generally blue. Their home ground is the 7,782-seater [[Botoșani Municipal Stadium]]."}}
